creda.tieRule: smallest ceiling among the tied: the same outcome for less adaptation is the weaker claim
creda.comparison: paired within (seed, transfer): every ceiling measured on the same material, so the cell's own difficulty cancels instead of drowning the effect
creda.inheritanceRule: a transfer the search measured runs at its own pick; one it never saw runs at `ceiling`, the pooled winner, applied out of sample
creda.byTransferSource: recomputed from the per-cell scores this same search printed, verified against the pooled grid and winner already in this record
